recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not restore the old drug database/inventory wording to the active MedicationKnowledge.status element unless Pharmacy reopens the MetadataResource decision. If stale generated diagrams or obsolete status terminology pages are still emitted, address that separately as generation or terminology-retirement cleanup rather than under FHIR-28598.
issue_request: FHIR-28598 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Pharmacy change request raised against R4 and applied for R5. It asked to clean up MedicationKnowledge.status so it described whether the medication referred to by the MedicationKnowledge was in active use within a drug database or inventory system, and to update the corresponding status-code definitions.
initial_application: Historical commit 7453f87bfcb5eeba6020113412508cb95e5d4f0a changed source/medicationknowledge/structuredefinition-MedicationKnowledge.xml to the requested drug-database/inventory wording, and commit 353a04689ac043c554bac32cf7a6bf9c5425dc99 added source/medicationknowledge/codesystem-medicationknowledge-status.xml with matching active, entered-in-error, and inactive definitions.
additional_context: Later Pharmacy issue FHIR-32801 made MedicationKnowledge a MetadataResource so it follows canonical and metadata resource patterns. The combined branch already contains 7161c9a41e0b10197fc857580413a05e5cdfcc92 for FHIR-32801, which intentionally changed the authoritative MedicationKnowledge.status element to publication-status lifecycle semantics. FHIR-42901 and FHIR-45285 are later same-family decisions reinforcing the CanonicalResource/MetadataResource direction. The old MedicationKnowledge status CodeSystem still contains the FHIR-28598 wording, while the checked-in SVG still shows old text and binding as a generated-looking stale surface.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Reapplying FHIR-28598 to the active MedicationKnowledge.status element would reintroduce pre-MetadataResource inventory-status semantics that have been superseded. The remaining source relevant to FHIR-28598's original status-code cleanup already contains the requested concept definitions.
